name: mabigfam

scripts.build: npm run build --workspace=server && npm run build --workspace=web
scripts.test: npm run test --workspace=server && npm run test --workspace=web
scripts.lint: npm run lint --workspace=server && npm run lint --workspace=web
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck --workspace=server && npm run typecheck --workspace=web
scripts.check: npm run typecheck && npm run lint && npm test

//overrides: react-family-tree and react-router declare open-ended peers (react >=16), so npm is free to satisfy them with a newer hoisted copy than web's pinned 18.3.1. When that happens react-family-tree builds elements with a different React than the app renders with, React throws, and the whole app unmounts — the Tree view goes blank. Pinning here forces one copy for every dependent. web/test/singleReact.test.ts guards it.
